_meta.description: AI-provider registry. Single source of truth for the wizard's provider picker, the orchestrator's container-image selection, the OneCLI secret config, and the dashboard's models page. See docs/PROVIDER_PLAYBOOK.md § 5.5 and docs/implementation/gemini-blueprint.md § 5.1.

anthropic.name: Anthropic Claude

subscription_auth.label: Use my Claude Pro/Max subscription
subscription_auth.tagline: Mint a long-lived token from your Claude subscription — no metered API key.
subscription_auth.docs_note: Uses your own Claude subscription via Anthropic's official `claude setup-token` (the same mechanism Claude Code uses). The token is long-lived (about a year) and does not auto-rotate — re-run the command to renew it. Treat it like a password. Note: from 2026-06-15, Agent SDK usage on subscription plans draws from a capped monthly credit.

anthropic.cost_hint: Roughly $2-4/day for a chatty WhatsApp group

gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.tagline: Generous free tier. Long context up to 2M tokens.
gemini.key_format_hint: Long alphanumeric string from Google AI Studio, often starting with AIza
gemini.cost_hint: Free tier covers light personal use. Paid: ~$0.50-2/day for chatty groups.
